entries.title: Debug a React app (console, DevTools, errors)
entries.summary: A routine for finding why something does not render or work.
entries.when: Page is blank, a button does nothing, data looks wrong.

code: 1. Look at the TERMINAL running 'npm run dev': syntax/import errors appear here.
2. Look at the red overlay in the browser: it shows file and line.
3. Open DevTools (F12) > Console: runtime errors; Network: failed requests; Elements: the rendered HTML.
4. Install the 'React Developer Tools' browser extension to inspect props and state.
steps.label: Order of checks

code: debugger   // execution pauses here when DevTools is open
steps.label: Breakpoint

entries.expected: You can name the failing file, line or request.
troubleshooting: Blank page + no error: check that main.jsx renders <App /> into #root and the route path matches the URL.
